confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, cappuccino, and beer anchors use Numbeo’s Tainan data, updated 14 October 2026; the city page notes a limited contributor base. Cocktail uses Nomadlio’s Tainan restaurant estimate. Wine by the glass is estimated from its local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates, not live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Tainan city data. Accommodation estimates reflect Tainan’s southern Taiwan secondary-city market, with Kaohsiung as a broad regional comparator.
